3: // ids are stable because they double as mpd-modelchain chain keys and are
4: // referenced across skills/docs; only the human-facing `name`/`description`
5: // were renamed to plain functional names. Hand-maintained since the one-time
6: // migration generator (scripts/gen-roles.mjs) lost its input preset tree.
7: // Consumer surfaces: mpd_roles_list / mpd_role_spawn (roster lookup),
8: // mpd_role_persona (text for spawn surfaces — the official Agent Teams
9: // `spawn_teammate` takes it as the teammate's prompt), and mpd_modelchain_resolve
10: // (chain lookup). Team mode is the OFFICIAL Agent Teams plugin, whose Lead stages
11: // these members BY NAME (`spawn_teammate` + `team_task_create`).
12: export interface MpdRoleSpec {
13:   /** The STABLE chain key — also the `personas/<id>.md` file name and the workmate `meta.baseId`. INTERNAL: no tool output, description, render, web route or GUI ever exposes it. */

15:   /** The functional display name a teammate is addressed by — the ONLY base key any tool accepts. */
16:   name: string
17:   /** One-line role summary, shown wherever the roster is listed. */
18:   description: string
19:   /** Read-only roles spawn with a write-tool deny filter; workers spawn unrestricted. */
20:   readonly: boolean
21:   /** The model-chain candidates for this member, tried in order by `mpd_modelchain_resolve`. */
22:   chain: Array<{ provider: string; model: string }>
23:   /** Path of the persona template, relative to this package, read by `mpd_role_persona`. */
24:   personaFile: string
25: }
